format_note_en: Part F specifies a checkpoint of comprehension, recognition and gap-fill. That mix does not fit a register module: there is nothing to gap-fill when every option is grammatical, and comprehension is not what is being tested. These checkpoints use four question types instead — which_situation, pick_register_for_audience, which_axis and same_meaning_other_layer. The third is the important one, because it tests the single idea the module exists to teach: that a difference between two sentences may be one of setting or one of vocabulary layer, and that these are not the same question. This is the same divergence from Part F recorded for Module 12's eight checkpoints, and for the same reason.

checkpoints.title_en: The two axes, and the situations

questions.explanation_en: It states a rule and addresses nobody. That is a sign.
The others are a sign, a regulation and something you would say to a stranger. Over-formality at home reads as distance.

questions.question_en: What kind of difference is this?
options: Situation — who is being spoken to
questions.explanation_en: Every content word is the same. Only the verb form and कृपया have changed, which is movement along the situation axis.

questions.question_en: What kind of difference is this?
options: Situation — who is being spoken to
questions.explanation_en: Both are polite and both address आप. What has changed is the layer the words come from.

questions.question_en: What tells you this is casual?
questions.explanation_en: तुम and हो have both gone. Casual speech is marked by what it drops.

questions.audience_en: Calling over a shopkeeper you have never met.
questions.explanation_en: तू would be an insult and तुम over-familiar. The fourth is institutional language aimed at one person.

questions.question_en: What does the -गा on the imperative add?
questions.explanation_en: कीजिएगा displaces the request into the future, which makes it unhurried rather than more formal.

questions.audience_en: The closing line of a written application to an institution.
options: अतः आपसे निवेदन है कि अनुमति प्रदान करें।
options_read_as: ataḥ aapse nivedan hai ki anumati pradaan kareṁ.
questions.explanation_en: अतः has no spoken life at all. The other three are a work message, casual speech and polite speech.

questions.sentence: सूचित किया जाता है कि कार्यालय बंद रहेगा।
questions.read_as: suuchit kiyaa jaataa hai ki kaaryaalay baṁd rahegaa.
questions.question_en: What makes this institutional rather than formal writing?
options: There is no writer and no addressee
questions.explanation_en: A letter has a महोदय at the top and a signature at the bottom. This has neither, and the habitual passive removes the last trace of anybody.

questions.question_en: Which word means the same thing on the Sanskrit-influenced side?
questions.explanation_en: धन्यवाद. Both are entirely current and the choice between them is one of setting.

questions.sentence: शहर में पानी की किल्लत, प्रदर्शन जारी
questions.read_as: shahar meṁ paanii kii killat, pradarshan jaarii
questions.explanation_en: No auxiliary, no conjunction, no full stop. Nothing else in Hindi is written this way.

questions.sentence: पर मुझे ये ठीक नहीं लगता।
questions.read_as: par mujhe ye ṭhiik nahiiṁ lagtaa.
questions.question_en: Why would a news report not print this?
options: It puts the reporter in the story
questions.explanation_en: मुझे लगता है is the one thing the register does not allow. Attribution is the whole convention.

questions.question_en: What kind of difference is this?
options: Both — the layer and the compound verb have changed together
questions.explanation_en: काम becomes कार्य, which is the tendency axis, and the vector हो गया disappears, which is the situation axis. The two often move together, and that is why they are easy to confuse.

questions.audience_en: Asking somebody at home to warm some water.
questions.explanation_en: The first is ceremonial and the second is a technical instruction. The fourth is possible in some households and unremarkable there.
पुस्तकालय rather than लाइब्रेरी, and nobody addressed. Somebody telling you would say लाइब्रेरी बंद रहेगी.

questions.question_en: Which word does the same job on the Sanskrit-influenced side?
questions.explanation_en: उत्तरदायी. The other three are all built with the same -दार and -मंद suffixes as ज़िम्मेदार itself.

questions.question_en: What kind of difference is this?
options: Situation — the layer has not changed
questions.explanation_en: शुक्रिया is Urdu-side in both. One is formal and one is casual, which shows the layer says nothing about the situation.

questions.sentence: संचिका अपलोड करके कड़ी साझा करें।
questions.read_as: saṁchikaa aploḍ karke kaṛii saajhaa kareṁ.
questions.explanation_en: संचिका and कड़ी are the official coinages for file and link. They exist, and they live on portals.

questions.audience_en: A quick instruction to a colleague on a work chat.
options: संचिका अपलोड करके कड़ी साझा करें।
फ़ाइल अपलोड करके लिंक शेयर कर दो।
options_read_as: saṁchikaa aploḍ karke kaṛii saajhaa kareṁ.
faail aploḍ karke liṁk sheyar kar do.
questions.explanation_en: In office life the English word is the word. The first would stop the conversation while everyone worked out what was meant.

questions.question_en: What does the गई tell you?
options: That कैंसिल is a Hindi word
That the speaker's Hindi is incomplete
That मीटिंग is feminine and the grammar is entirely Hindi
questions.explanation_en: Three English words and every ending Hindi. Code-switching is one grammar running on borrowed vocabulary.
